Name: Betwitched
Author: bewandert
Description:
[size=6]Betwitched[/size]

A Stardew Valley Twitch mod.

Version 0.9.0

This is a beta version! Use it at your own risk!

[b]Regarding SDV update 1.5.5 and SMAPI update 3.13.1:[/b] I have tested this mod and
it seems to be compatible to the new updates!

[size=5]Features
[/size]
[list]
[*]connects to your twitch chat
[*]retrieves chat user names
[*]propose those names when naming newborn or animals
[*]fallback to vanilla when there aren’t enough chat user names available
[*]farmer speech bubbles informing you about new subs
[*]new chat command to fill a farmers speech bubble, for free or for bits
[*]speech bubbles for all named in game characters with their chat content
[*]optional black listing e.g. bots
[/list]
[size=5]Details[/size]

Takes user names from your Twitch channel chat and propose them for naming newborn or bought animals.
Let your chat users directly participate in your game!

[b]NEW:  Farmer speech bubbles informing you about new subs, speech bubbles for all named in game characters with their chat content and an optional new command!
[/b]
Only those users are considered which either wrote a message, subscribed, raided or were otherwise public visible,  so lurkers aren't touched.

[i]Please note[/i]: You need to edit the file 'config.json' and add TwitchAPI credentials in order that the mod works.
A detailed instruction is provided in the readme.md.

[b]See readme.md for further details.[/b]
